label: Order of being by approach to a primary: ApproachToPrimaryReading InAct MoreIn r near p: the…
term: order of being by approach to a primary (attribution order model)
definition: `ApproachToPrimaryReading InAct MoreIn r near p`: the primary p has r, and x is more r than y exactly when x approaches p more nearly (near y < near x, degrees in their own Mathlib `Preorder`). It does not say that nothing else reaches p (that is DEF-STRICT-PRIMACY, an open premise) and says nothing about causation; the causal order of creatures to the primary is the separate STMT-CREATURES-ORDERED-TO-PRIMARY-AS-CAUSE.
